children: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM), one of the nation’s leading consumer healthcare companies, has earned
2026 Great Place To Work Certification™
for the fifth consecutive year and has again been named to the
PEOPLE Companies That Care
list. Together, these recognitions reflect Humana’s continued focus on building a workplace where employees feel supported, connected to purpose and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

Great Place to Work certification is based on direct employee feedback about workplace culture, trust, and overall experience. In 2026, 79% of Humana employees said the company is a great place to work, compared with 57% of employees at a typical U.S.-based company. Survey results also highlight that 90% of employees said they feel welcome when they join the company, 86% said they feel good about the ways Humana contributes to the community, and 84% said people care about each other at Humana.

Published by PEOPLE, the Companies That Care list recognizes U.S. companies that have succeeded in business while demonstrating outstanding respect, care and concern for their employees, communities and the environment. Humana’s continued recognition underscores the company’s focus on supporting teammates, strengthening communities and making it easier for the millions of people it serves to achieve their best health.

“These recognitions are especially meaningful because they reflect the experiences our teammates help create every day,” said Michelle O’Hara, Chief Human Resources Officer for Humana. “Our people are the driving force behind Humana’s purpose and success. When teammates feel valued, supported and connected to meaningful work, they are empowered to innovate, collaborate and make a greater impact. That not only strengthens our culture—it helps us better serve our members and patients, support our communities and deliver on our commitment to helping people achieve their best health.”

Over the past year, Humana has continued to advance its culture and community impact through efforts that support employee engagement, whole-person health and service to others. Examples of how Humana’s culture showed up in action over the past year include:
Humana Community Day
: More than 12,000 associates participated in the 2025 Community Day, supporting 600 nonprofit organizations and impacting 1.6 million lives.
Volunteerism:
Humana associates contributed more than 321,000 volunteer hours throughout 2025.
Network Resource Groups:
More than 20,000 associates participated in one or more affinity groups that foster connection, development and belonging.
Veteran Support:
Humana engages in dedicated programs, resources and external partnerships to support its 4,500 veterans and military-connected teammates.

Humana has also enhanced learning opportunities, modernized performance management and enhanced well-being programs to provide employees with clearer expectations, meaningful feedback and greater career development support.
About Humana

Humana (NYSE:HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell® healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. About Great Place To Work Certification™

Great Place To Work® Certification™ is the most definitive “employer-of-choice” recognition that companies aspire to achieve. It is the only recognition based entirely on what employees report about their workplace experience – specifically, how consistently they experience a high-trust workplace. Great Place To Work Certification is recognized worldwide by employees and employers alike and is the global benchmark for identifying and recognizing outstanding employee experience. Every year, more than 10,000 companies across 60 countries apply to get Great Place To Work-Certified.
About Great Place To Work

As the global authority on workplace culture, Great Place To Work® brings 30 years of groundbreaking research and data to help every place become a Great Place To Work for all. Their proprietary platform and For All™ Model helps companies evaluate the experience of every employee, with exemplary workplaces becoming Great Place To Work Certified™ or receiving recognition on a coveted Best Workplaces™ List.
Learn more at
and follow Great Place To Work on LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.
About the PEOPLE Companies That Care List

Great Place To Work selected the 2025 PEOPLE Companies that Care List by gathering and analyzing over 1.3 million confidential survey responses from companies representing more than 8.4 million U.S. employees at Great Place To Work Certified organizations. Of those, more than 1 million responses came from employees at companies eligible for the list and these rankings are based on that feedback. Company rankings are derived from 60 employee experience questions within the Great Place To Work Trust Index™ Survey and essays submitted by participating companies. Read the full methodology.
